title: Sweet Talkers: How Query Formulation Shapes Sycophancy in Romantic Relationship Advice

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to romantic relationship advice prompts using the ELEPHANT framework across four dimensions (validation, indirectness, framing, and moral), and analyzing how grammatical mood and perspective-flipping affect the model's tendency to excessively agree with or validate the user.

Comparing LLM-as-a-judge automated scores of their own generated responses against human-annotated ground truth scores to detect if models evaluate their own outputs more favorably than those generated by other models.
